response.sql: WITH transaction_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), transaction_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM transaction_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count, AVG(share_of_total) AS average_share FROM transaction_shares GROUP BY tradekind;
